translations.web: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, because you will become desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith Jehovah.
